compaction.inv02_explanation: The checker's INV-02 rule flags any .now() call in a module through an AST match. The 180k and 100k arms replaced datetime.datetime.now() with clock.now(), which is the sanctioned fix but still matches the rule. The other three arms deleted the unused _stamp line. No arm calls datetime.now() directly in a module.
compaction.w140k_reconciliation_note: The 140k arm reported all 12 CHECK_ANOMALY rows in phases 1-3, but its RECONCILIATION.md does not repeat them because the phase 4 prompt did not ask for anomalies.
compaction.validity_gate: first preTokens within 15% of the predicted threshold (benchmarks/protocol.md). window_180k (+15.7%) and compound_25pct_250k (+55.5%) fail it.

setup.isolated_arm: 3 fresh sessions, equivalent to /clear between tasks

units.name: cache-weighted units
units.definition: usd / input list price x 1e6, i.e. input 1, 5m write 1.25, 1h write 2, read 0.05, output 5

ttl_runs.design: Two sessions each built about 97k tokens of context on one codebase task. The hot session was resumed 3.3 minutes later, inside the 5-minute cache window, for one quick fix. The stale session was resumed three times, each more than 10 minutes after its last call, for three quick fixes. Each stale fix was paired with the same fix in a brand-new session, the same as /clear. n=1 per condition: 1 hot run, 3 stale and fresh pairs.
ttl_runs.units_note: cache-weighted units, Opus 5.5 weights input 1, 5m write 1.25, 1h write 2, read 0.05, output 5; read weight sensitivity 0.1 and 0.025

invariants.note: The third fresh session started about 34 minutes after the third stale run because the machine paused. It was still a cold start.

compact_runs.command: claude -p "/compact Keep: the 3 issues found, files touched, test command" --resume SESSION
compact_runs.design: Manual /compact on a ~97k-token session, then the same quick fix used in ttl_runs. Compact after the break: the two ttl_runs sessions, already hours past the 5-minute cache, were compacted and then given one fix right away. Compact before the break: three fresh ~97k builds were compacted within a minute (cache warm), left for more than 6 minutes, then given the fix. Baseline is the fresh /clear run of the same fix in ttl_runs. n=2 after, n=3 before.
compact_runs.units_note: cache-weighted units, Opus 5.5 weights input 1, 5m write 1.25, 1h write 2, read 0.05, output 5; read weight sensitivity 0.1 and 0.025

invariants.note: The compact call is not written to the transcript as an assistant row; its tokens come from Claude Code's cost_state totals. The third before-break run waited about 11 minutes instead of 6 because its runner stopped on a bug and the fix was resumed by hand.
